title: Egg-y Flambe Saujaek Pilaf
description: This egg-y flambe saeujeot-shrimp-paste pilaf combines a fermented, fluffy Argentinian dish with render-fat for a delicious and diabetic-friendly one-pot meal.
instructions: Soak the rice in water for at least an hour.
Heat the render-fat in a saucepan, add saeujeot-shrimp-paste and cook until fragrant.
Add rice and stir to coat, then pour in the soaked rice. Mix well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed.
Gently crack eggs into the pilaf mixture, stirring continuously to prevent curdling.
Cook for another minute before serving hot with a side of lemon wedges.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper according to taste.
